risk_if_not_implemented: Without Update Vulnerability Scanning Tools, known and exploitable vulnerabilities may remain unaddressed, giving adversaries readily available entry points. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Update Tool Capability (VPM-12.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability Remediation Process
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that vulnerabilities are properly identified, tracked and remediated.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability Remediation Process (VPM-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Update Tool Capability (VPM-12.1) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
